tests.note: Full12-test module before the additional stale-idle subcase; production source identical to final.

retained_prototype_failure.meaning: Initial uncommitted gate prototype falsely marked input supplied on closed column-info channel; not an unmodified upstream baseline test.

behavior.write_success_failed_unit: rows counted once per logical final outcome
behavior.write_uncertain_count: subset of WriteFailedCount; rows may already be committed and are never blindly replayed
behavior.retry_endpoint: same chosen endpoint; round-robin advances once only after the logical batch
behavior.original_CKItems: already released in Cache.Add; retries retain only serialized columnBlock and order

boundaries: No vendor or other production module changes. No commit/push, service start/restart, Agent startup or traffic generation performed by this subtask.

Unit fault peer uses real native protocol/ch-go via net.Pipe; it models accepted input and missing ACK but is not a real ClickHouse durability test. Root owns full official Server build and lab fault injection.
A cold connection-refused outage can exhaust three attempts in roughly200ms; this is not a19s outage recovery guarantee. Root requested actual fault measurement before changing wait policy.
Post-supply network/timeout errors are deliberately uncertain and not retried; no exactly-once or zero-loss claim is made.
Table initialization/DDL paths retain their existing separate error/drop behavior. The10s budget covers Cache.Write attempts, not every startup/DDL operation.
Malformed empty-metadata+EOS waits for bounded batch deadline before failing without input. Callback waits on driver child context to preserve original EOF/Exception.
